messages:
maria: heads up — the new quant-eval ingest is hitting the pipeline rate cap and it's blocking the curation backfill we scheduled. noticed ~18k items queued.
jon: ugh, is this the kafka-to-s3 job or the labeling webhook? :thinking_face:
maria: webhook. we rolled the stricter rate limit yesterday to avoid overloading labeler workers after the quant experiments spiked request sizes.
sam: can we pause the webhook and do a batched backfill instead? that would give labelers a steady stream.
anya: pause is fine for the live stream, but we need to ensure the backfill respects dedupe tokens and golden flags. last time we re-ingested duplicates into the golden set.
maria: agreed. plan proposal:
- pause webhook ingestion for the next 2h
- prepare a deduped backfill manifest (S3) with `source_id`, `fingerprint`, `priority_tag`
- run backfill ingestion job with `--rate 200/s` and `--dry-run` first
- have labelers pick from the `backfill-queue` with a separate priority bucket
jon: sounds good. can you paste the example manifest format?
maria: sure:
```
[
  {"source_id":"src-2026-04-09-0001","fingerprint":"fp_abc123","priority_tag":"backfill-low"},
  {"source_id":"src-2026-04-09-0002","fingerprint":"fp_def456","priority_tag":"backfill-high","golden":true}
]
```
sam: small nit: use `priority: high|low` instead of `priority_tag` so the ingestion lambda maps directly to queue sharding.
maria: ok i'll update. also adding `origin:quant-eval-1` so we can filter later.
curation-bot: automated check — current backfill manifest candidate size: 17,934 items. estimated processing time at 200/s = ~90 minutes.
anya: do we want to hold anything out for golden QA? i recommend 1% from high priority flagged as manual-review.
sam: +1 on 1% holdout. label-bot can tag those with `manual-golden-review`.
label-bot: will tag on ingestion when `priority: high` and `golden` not explicitly true.
jon: operational play: run `ingest --manifest s3://redwood-backfills/quant-2026-04-09.json --rate 200 --dedupe --holdout 0.01`; run in staging first.
maria: i'll create the backfill object and kick off a staging dry-run at `1728603800` (ETA 10m).
anya: once dry-run OK, i'll spin up an extra pool of labelers for 2 hours to catch up backlog.
sam: reminder: update the rollout doc with `#backfill-run` notes and link to the manifest.
maria: done. manifest uploaded: `s3://redwood-backfills/quant-2026-04-09-v2.json`.
jon: running dry-run now.
curation-bot: dry-run summary — duplicates filtered: 3,421, candidates: 14,513, holdouts flagged: 145.
maria: looks safe. scheduling live backfill at 1728604100 with rate 200/s. pausing webhook in 60s.
label-bot: label queues will surface `backfill-high` in `queue:backfill:high` and `backfill-low` in `queue:backfill:low`.
anya: monitoring note — watch for labeler latency > 5m, rollback if >10% error rate.
jon: backfill started. logs: `ingest: started manifest quant-2026-04-09-v2, pid=7421`.
sam: keeping an eye on SLO dashboard. if token throughput spikes, we throttle to 100/s and alert.
maria: post-run ops: create mini-runbook with counts (processed, deduped, golden-marked), and run a random spot-check of 200 items for quality regression vs baseline model.
anya: i'll coordinate the spot-check checklist (2 annotators per item, consensus threshold 0.8).
maria: thanks all. will post postmortem if we hit any regressions. :thumbsup:
